page_title: BAY 5-1 RBL | Bayern Munich v RB Leipzig 20/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Daniel Siebert is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
90+1' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.
90' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
90' The linesman signals a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
87' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Harry Kane and he is replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
84' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
83' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
82' Marco Rose has decided to make a change. Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig) replaces Arthur Vermeeren.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lutsharel Geertruida departs the field of play to be replaced by David Raum (RB Leipzig).
82' Substitution. Michael Olise makes his way off the pitch and Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
82' Substitution. Alphonso Davies did his best and is replaced by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich).
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) for Min-Jae Kim.
82' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
81' RB Leipzig hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
78' 5 - 1 Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.

75' 4 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
74' The game has come to an end for Benjamin Sesko. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Andre Silva (RB Leipzig).
74' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Xaver Schlager will be replaced by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
72' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
71' The ball possession at the moment is 68:32.
69' It's time for a substitution. Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Konrad Laimer.

67' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Peter Gulacsi is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.

66' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
64' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniel Siebert ignores the protests.
63' RB Leipzig are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
60' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
59' A yellow card for a tackle by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig). Daniel Siebert doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
58' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
56' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.

53' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
52' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
51' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

49' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi pulls off a brilliant save.
49' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
48' The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) heads on.
45+1' Referee Daniel Siebert halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Marco Rose, then shows him a yellow.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' The free kick is delivered by Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
42' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. RB Leipzig get a free kick.
39' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Peter Gulacsi pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
38' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Daniel Siebert immediately signals a free kick.
36' 3 - 1 Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the right post.
34' The total number of attempts is 8:1.
32' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.
29' Peter Gulacsi leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).
27' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) sees a yellow card from Daniel Siebert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
25' 2 - 1 What a hit! Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top of the net. 2:1.
24' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Siebert signals a foul. RB Leipzig win a free kick.
23' The cross into the penalty area from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
21' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
20' The foul by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniel Siebert.
19' A player from Bayern Munich commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
17' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
16' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
16' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' Some neat passing and movement from Bayern Munich as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
13' It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.

13' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.

11' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.

10' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Peter Gulacsi pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
9' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for an infringement. Bayern Munich have a free kick.
8' Corner kick. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is ready to send the ball into the box.
7' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes a short corner kick.
5' The game is interrupted as Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) is flagged offside.
2' 1 - 1 Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and fires into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
1' 1 - 0 Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Daniel Siebert is introduced as the referee for today's match.
